CHIN 100AM.t: Third-Year Chinese for Mandarin and Dialect Speakers I
CHIN 100AM.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course for students who have received some prior formal training in Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence that further expands more advanced oral and written communicative competence through study of topics including the history of Chinese language and society, education, and literature.
CHIN 100AM.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 100AN.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course for students who have received some prior formal training in Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence that further expands more advanced oral and written communicative competence through study of topics including the history of Chinese language and society, education, and literature.
CHIN 100AN.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview .

CHIN 100BM.t: Third-Year Chinese for Mandarin and Dialect Speakers II
CHIN 100BM.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral or written proficiency in Mandarin or another Chinese dialect. Part two of a three-quarter sequence that further expands more complex oral and written communicative competence through study of topics including the history of Chinese language and society, education, and literature.
CHIN 100BM.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 100BN.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course for students who have received some prior training in Mandarin. CHIN 100BN.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 100CM.t: Third-Year Chinese for Mandarin and Dialect Speakers III
CHIN 100CM.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral or written proficiency in Mandarin or another Chinese dialect. Part three of a three-quarter sequence that further expands more complex oral and written communicative competence through study of topics including the history of Chinese language and society, education, and literature.
CHIN 100CM.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 100CN.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course for students who have received some prior training in Mandarin. CHIN 10AD.t: First-Year Chinese for Dialect Speakers I
CHIN 10AD.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some proficiency in a Chinese dialect other than Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence covering fundamentals of pronunciation, Chinese grammar, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10AD.pre: placement interview required for department approval to enroll.

CHIN 10AM.t: First-Year Chinese for Mandarin Speakers I
CHIN 10AM.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral proficiency but who have not had formal written training in Mandarin. Part one of a three-quarter sequence focusing on increasing literacy with basic characters and covering fundamentals of Chinese grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10AM.pre: placement interview required for department approval to enroll.

CHIN 10AN.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course for students with no Chinese language experience. Part one of a three-quarter sequence that covers foundational pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10AN.pre: placement interview required for department approval to enroll.

CHIN 10BD.t: First-Year Chinese for Dialect Speakers II
CHIN 10BD.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some proficiency in a Chinese dialect other than Mandarin. Part two of a three-quarter sequence that expands competence in Chinese grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10BD.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 10BM.t: First-Year Chinese for Mandarin Speakers II
CHIN 10BM.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral proficiency but who have not had significant written training in Mandarin; part two of a three-quarter sequence focusing on increasing literacy with additional characters.
CHIN 10BM.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 10BN.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course for students with little to no Chinese language experience. Part two of a three-quarter sequence that covers foundational pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10BN.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 10CD.t: First-Year Chinese for Dialect Speakers III
CHIN 10CD.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some proficiency in a Chinese dialect other than Mandarin. Part three of a three-quarter sequence that expands competence in Chinese grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10CD.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 10CM.t: First-Year Chinese for Mandarin Speakers III
CHIN 10CM.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course intended for students with some oral proficiency but who have not had significant written training in Mandarin. Part three of a three-quarter sequence focusing on increasing literacy with additional characters and expanding competence in Chinese grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10CM.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 10CN.desc: Introductory Mandarin Chinese language course for students with some basic Chinese language experience. Part three of a three-quarter sequence that covers foundational pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary through interactive classes.
CHIN 10CN.pre: previous course or department approval through placement interview.

CHIN 160.t: Late Imperial and Twentieth-Century Chinese Historical Texts
CHIN 160.desc: This course introduces the primary sources used by historians of late Imperial and twentieth-century Chinese history. Reading material includes diaries, newspaper articles, Qing documents, gazetteers, essays, speeches, popular fiction, journal articles, scholarly prose, and field surveys. May be repeated for credit. (P/NP grades only.)
CHIN 160.pre: advanced knowledge of Chinese language and consent of instructor.

CHIN 165A.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on oral and written communication skills for business, including introduction to modern business terminology and social conventions.
CHIN 165A.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 100CM, CHIN 100CN, CHIN 165B-C, CHIN 185A-B-C.

CHIN 165B.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on oral and written communication skills for business, including introduction to modern business terminology and social conventions.
CHIN 165B.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 100CM, CHIN 100CN, CHIN 165A, CHIN 165C, CHIN 185A-B-C.

CHIN 165C.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on oral and written communication skills for business, including introduction to modern business terminology and social conventions.
CHIN 165C.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 100CM, CHIN 100CN, CHIN 165A-B, CHIN 185A-B-C.

CHIN 169A.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on conversational medical Chinese for students interested in medicine and health care. Designed to prepare students to speak, listen, and read effectively in a Chinese medical environment and build necessary medical vocabulary.
CHIN 169A.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169B, CHIN 182A-B-C.

CHIN 169B.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on conversational medical Chinese for students interested in medicine and health care. Designed to prepare students to speak, listen, and read effectively in a Chinese medical environment and build necessary medical vocabulary.
CHIN 169B.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A, CHIN 182A-B-C.

CHIN 182A.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Basic structures and function words are taught through fables of the pre-Qing period.
CHIN 182A.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182B-C, CHIN 185A-B-C.

CHIN 182B.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Selections from Kongzi, Mengzi, and work of other philosophers will be taught. Focus is on structures, function words, and overall comprehension of a text.
CHIN 182B.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182A, CHIN 182C, CHIN 185A-B-C.

CHIN 182C.desc: Advanced Mandarin Chinese language course that focuses on building familiarity with classical Chinese. Selections from later periods like Shiji and poetry will be introduced. Focus is on structures, function words, and overall comprehension of a text.
CHIN 182C.pre: any one of the following or department approval through placement interview: CHIN 165A-B-C, CHIN 169A-B, CHIN 182A-B, CHIN 185A-B-C.
